description: A series of mysterious thefts have plagued the art community in Southern Europe. As whispers of a notorious art thief resurface, you must navigate through the vibrant streets of three cities, piecing together clues that lead to the final confrontation. Each suspect presents a façade, but only one holds the key to unraveling this intricate web of deception.
